inputs.issue_title: Add caching layer to user service
inputs.plan:
1. Modify pkg/cache/redis_adapter.go to add a TTL-based cache wrapper around UserService.GetByID
2. Update internal/service/user.go to call cache.WrapWithTTL() before database lookup
3. Add tests in pkg/cache/redis_adapter_test.go
inputs.gathered_context: The project has no pkg/cache/ directory. There is no redis_adapter.go file. The user service is at internal/service/user.go and uses a PostgreSQL repository pattern. No caching infrastructure exists in the project.
inputs.conventions: Errors wrap with fmt.Errorf. No external dependencies beyond stdlib.

assertions.value: The coder should detect that the plan references files and functions that do not exist (pkg/cache/redis_adapter.go, cache.WrapWithTTL). It should return PLAN_INFEASIBLE: with a concrete explanation of what is wrong. It should NOT attempt to generate code implementing the plan. Check that the response starts with PLAN_INFEASIBLE: and explains which referenced symbols or files are missing.
